title: Copilot Studio: share agents with other makers on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the checklist presents a Copilot Studio per-user licence as required for Editor recipients, although the briefing itself says that requirement is unresolved. The roadmap facts and sharing controls are supported; the admin path needs only a more specific ending.

claims.claim: The documented Editor-sharing script retrieves the environment using Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId>.
claims.quote: $environment = Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId>

claims.claim: The documented Editor-sharing script assigns the environment's governanceConfiguration to $governanceConfiguration.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration = $environment.Internal.properties.governanceConfiguration

claims.claim: The documented script adds bot-authoringSharingDisabled with value True using the printed Add-Member operation.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-authoringSharingDisabled' -Value True -Force

claims.claim: That script disables sharing with individuals as Editors, rather than disabling Viewer sharing.
claims.quote: Here's a PowerShell script that turns off the ability to share your agents with individuals as Editors. ... Set 'bot-authoringSharingDisabled' to False to enable sharing with individuals as Editors.

claims.claim: Limit sharing documents bot-limitSharingMode for the agent security-group sharing restriction.
claims.quote: $governanceConfiguration.settings.extendedSettings | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'bot-limitSharingMode' -Value "ExcludeSharingToSecurityGroups" -Force

claims.claim: Limit sharing documents bot-maxLimitUserSharing for the agent viewer limit.
claims.quote: Here's a PowerShell script that prevents agents from being shared with security groups and limits the number of viewers that can access an agent to 20. ... -Name 'bot-maxLimitUserSharing' -Value "20" -Force

claims.claim: Sharing limits apply only to agents requiring authentication.
claims.quote: Sharing limits only apply to agents that require authentication.

claims.claim: Sharing controls can be applied at scale using environment groups and rules.
claims.quote: You can configure these controls for an individual Managed Environment, or you can apply the sharing controls at scale using Environment Groups and Rules in the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Users who only use the agent can receive end-user access instead of viewing/testing or editing access.
claims.quote: If you just want to share the agent for other people to use, without viewing or testing, under Organization, open the dropdown menu and select End user access. This action allows anyone in your organization to find and use the agent, but they can't display the agent's details or edit it.

claims.claim: Tools configured with end-user credentials use each user's own connection at runtime.
claims.quote: Connections configured to use end-user credentials aren't subject to this connection-sharing restriction because each user authenticates by using their own connection at runtime.
